Quinn Alvarez: hey team, quick setup Q for my first week — where is the canonical employee handbook and the onboarding templates in Notion? i'm trying to copy the incident playbook and weekly 1:1 template but can't find them. who owns those pages?

Rosa Park: welcome Quinn! :wave: handbook and core onboarding live in Redwood Inference > Company Handbook and Company > Onboarding Templates. incident playbook is under Incidents > Playbooks (owner: eng-sre). 1:1 template is under People Ops > Templates.

Quinn Alvarez: i can see Company but not Incidents. SSO shows i'm in the workspace. pages return 403 when opening links.

Ben Cho: 403 usually means restricted view. Owners put restrictions on incident docs. Two quick options: 1) file docs-perms (https://redwood.in/forms/docs-perms) with the page links, or 2) ask an owner directly — ping eng-sre or people-ops. If you want, i can add you as viewer on the handbook now.

Quinn Alvarez: would appreciate the viewer access so I can duplicate the 1:1 template.

ops-bot: Ticket DOCS-8001 created for Quinn Alvarez requesting viewer/edit access for "Incident Playbook" and "Weekly 1:1 (Template)". Owner: eng-sre. ETA: 1 business day.

Ben Cho: added Quinn as viewer on Company Handbook and Weekly 1:1 template. Note: incident playbook is restricted for on-call rotation reasons; owners must approve duplication.

Quinn Alvarez: can see the handbook and the 1:1 now — thanks! one more thing: if i duplicate the incident playbook for a personal checklist, should i keep the original links intact or update them?

Rosa Park: duplicate into your Private pages, change links that reference team-specific runbooks to your copy, and keep the original incident references (pager duty, escalation) pointing to the canonical pages. Tag eng-sre for review if you change escalation steps.

Quinn Alvarez: got it, will duplicate and prefix the title with QA- to avoid confusion. appreciate the help :raised_hands:
